name: bwsyncandshare
postStartCommand: sudo sed -i 's/#user_allow_other/user_allow_other/g' /etc/fuse.conf && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y rclone fuse3 && rclone config create nextcloud webdav url=$NC_URL vendor=nextcloud user=$NC_USER pass=$(rclone obscure $NC_PASS) && mkdir -p cloud-share && fusermount3 -u cloud-share || true && rclone mount nextcloud: cloud-share --allow-other --vfs-cache-mode full --daemon
